high_level_description: This image captures a group of three individuals posing together outdoors on what appears to be a sunny day at a tennis event. The setting includes a green fence in the background, with tall residential buildings visible beyond it. There are also spectators in the background, some of whom are taking photos or videos. The three individuals in the foreground are dressed casually. The person on the left is wearing a light pink button-up shirt and sunglasses, while the person in the middle is dressed in a blue and white striped shirt over a white t-shirt and also wearing sunglasses.
